name: delay-updates-until-ack-of-gives-up-after-30-seconds
description: delayUpdatesUntilAckOf holds changes, but not answers, until the Envoy ACKs that type, and gives up after 30 seconds from the stream's first request. With no timer, the change goes on the first request after that.

steps.comment: Held: the Envoy hasn't ACKed RDS
Nothing happens until a request or an update
